asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on DOT. I'm currently here on the four-hour timeframe, and we can see that DOT has bounced from the November low. I mentioned to you guys this area is quite an important support cluster, around $2.30, and so a bounce is not a surprise. However, I wouldn't say there is any meaningful break above any resistances. We have a Fibonacci resistance area. Micro resistance between three dollars and twelve, and four dollars and twenty-two. This is being still respected. In fact, the price got rejected exactly from the 50% retracement level. We started a small pullback. This pullback is, at the moment on a three wave structure. And the support zone is between $2.55 and $3.01. So we have a bounce and the pullback. And I treat this as an AB structure with a possible C wave to come. The reason why I treat this predominantly as a corrective bounce is because it is a three-wave move up. This is not five waves up. I mean, I can be wrong about it, but it's not clearly five wave move up. In fact, it's such a clear three wave move that you can even labor the microstructures really, really accurately if you really wanted to. So I could say, hey, I've got an A, B, C and the C wave is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. It's perfect. Perfect. Three wave move that does not rule out higher prices. And the C wave is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. It's a perfect three-wave move that does not rule out higher prices. In fact, as long as the pullback unfolds as a three wave move as well, A, B, C, which could even get another low, the support area could provide, well, support and maybe even be a springboard for at least a C wave rally. If something more bullish plays out, then our signal for that would be a break above resistance around $4.21. But I'm going to watch this support zone for reactions between $2.55 and $3.01. And if this is a B wave pullback or if it is a wave two pullback, we might actually see a reaction to this Fibonacci micro support zone. And then followed if we see any impulsive reaction here, it might take the market to roundabout $4.20. This is where probably a lot of resistance will come in because this is the 78.6 retracement, typically a very strong resistance level, but also where we have a lot of we had a lot of trading activity in this area. And therefore naturally, there should be some resistance in that region. So that means in other words, I don't really have a very meaningful upside reversal pattern. But a larger three wave bounce is absolutely possible, and for anything more bullish, we will need a break above $4.22. That's the update on DOT hope you enjoyed the update. If you did, please hit that like button, leave a comment and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates then make sure to also check out our X channel for additional charts, updates, news and much more. I'll leave a link in the comment section. There are exclusive videos here. Sometimes videos are published a little sooner, so if you don't want to miss out on anything, feel free to follow us here as well.
